questions.prompt: What 1974 federal court order sparked years of violent protests in South Boston?
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Sully lived through '74. Said it tore the neighborhood apart. But we survived. We always do.
questions.npcReactionWrong: You don't know about the busing crisis? And you want to own a bar in Southie?

questions.prompt: What is the name of the famous St. Patrick's Day parade route that runs through South Boston?
choices: The Irish Pride Parade along West Broadway
The Celtic Walk through East Broadway
The Shamrock March down Dorchester Avenue
The South Boston St. Patrick's Day Parade along Broadway
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Every March, this neighborhood becomes the center of the universe. Been running since 1901.
questions.npcReactionWrong: Broadway, kid. The parade's been running since 1901. Sully never missed one.

questions.prompt: South Boston is surrounded by water on three sides. Which of these is NOT a Southie beach?
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Carson, L Street, M Street... take your pick. Sully swam at all of 'em. In January.
questions.npcReactionWrong: Revere Beach is up north. Carson, L Street, M Street, Pleasure Bay - those are ours.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the notorious gangster who ran South Boston's criminal underworld for decades?
questions.npcReactionCorrect: Whitey. Everyone knew. Nobody talked. That's how things worked back then.
questions.npcReactionWrong: Whitey Bulger. And if Sully were here, he'd tell you he never met the man. Whether that's true... well.

questions.prompt: What do locals call the L Street Brownies?
choices: The winter swimming club who swims year-round
questions.npcReactionCorrect: They've been doing it since 1902. Sully did it once. Said never again.
questions.npcReactionWrong: L Street Brownies. They've been jumping in the ocean every day since 1902. Even in February.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What movie filmed in South Boston won the Academy Award for Best Picture in 2007?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Sully hated it. Said they 'got the accent wrong.' Watched it twelve times.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: The Departed. Hollywood came here, butchered the accent, won an Oscar.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What year did South Boston officially become part of the City of Boston?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: 1804. We weren't always Boston's. Some days, we still don't feel like it.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: 1804. Southie wasn't always Boston. Got annexed like everybody else eventually.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What major convention center opened in South Boston in 2004?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: The BCEC. Changed everything. Brought suits and conferences. Not sure that's better.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: Boston Convention and Exhibition Center. Something changed Southie in 2004. Not everyone likes it.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What holiday, unique to Boston, coincidentally falls on St. Patrick's Day and celebrates the British evacuation in 1776?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Evacuation Day. March 17, 1776. Washington put cannons on Dorchester Heights and the British left. We get two holidays in one.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: Evacuation Day. Same day as St. Patrick's Day. Coincidence? Maybe. Good excuse for a longer celebration? Definitely.

alternateQuestions.prompt: What is the name of the peninsula in South Boston that includes Castle Island and a popular beach?
alternateQuestions.npcReactionCorrect: Pleasure Bay. Castle Island, the lagoon, the walkway. Sully walked it every Sunday morning. Said it cleared his head.
alternateQuestions.npcReactionWrong: Pleasure Bay. Best views in the city if you know where to look. And it's free.

redemptionChallenge.instructions: Select the correct Boston pronunciation for each street name.
redemptionChallenge.npcPassResponse: Alright, alright. You sound like you might actually belong here. Let's try this again.
redemptionChallenge.npcFailResponse: You said 'Wor-chester.' Get out. Come back when you can talk like a human being.
